notes: The incident date is entered one glyph per box as DD/MM/YYYY; the web field is an HTML date input and needs YYYY-MM-DD.
Fee fields are numeric inputs: thousands separators must be dropped.
Sections C(1), C(2) and C(3) are three branches; only the one matching the ticked Nature of Claim carries values. Filling a shaded branch counts as an unsupported value.
'Not Applicable' is pre-printed in structurally void cells and must not be copied into the web form.
